# Introduction   [Skip link to Introduction](https://developers.typeface.ai/docs/integrations-hubspot-cdp\#introduction)

This guide provides step-by-step instructions for setting up the HubSpot connector in Typeface for CDP-related use cases.

| Use Cases |
| --- |
| Import Audience Segments |

# Prerequisites   [Skip link to Prerequisites](https://developers.typeface.ai/docs/integrations-hubspot-cdp\#prerequisites)

Before starting, ensure you have the following:

- An active Hubspot account.
- Administrative access to the Hubspot.
- A Typeface account with necessary permissions.

# Connector Setup   [Skip link to Connector Setup](https://developers.typeface.ai/docs/integrations-hubspot-cdp\#connector-setup)

## Step 1: Creating API-KEY   [Skip link to Step 1: Creating API-KEY](https://developers.typeface.ai/docs/integrations-hubspot-cdp\#step-1-creating-api-key)

1. Navigate to Account > Profile & Preferences > Integrations > Private App > Legacy App > Create legacy app.



![](https://files.readme.io/e729c7dc72accdc1a43e4d46127266e99377e54fc41a84f8db61b695811dc6b6-image.png)

![](https://files.readme.io/198e29111ac740573eaf85198593e65ccc523ff024e4827d8bfe001e07a4e45d-image.png)


2. Select required scopes by searching for:

a. Content

b. Files

c. [crm.lists.read](https://developers.typeface.ai/docs/crm.lists.read "crm.lists.read")



![](https://files.readme.io/15c1f5bfde62f17949bc76a67e352d014a449bb66e7d9f7e11a346df9a219fa2-image.png)

3. Create the legacy app, then copy the access token from the Auth tab.



![](https://files.readme.io/c8e893701de6a773c6c218dd9a8dfdabcb7e299fae0d6f9d4d421e08bee6c041-image.png)


## Step 2: Configuring the Hubspot Connector in Typeface   [Skip link to Step 2: Configuring the Hubspot Connector in Typeface](https://developers.typeface.ai/docs/integrations-hubspot-cdp\#step-2-configuring-the-hubspot-connector-in-typeface)

1. As an organization or team administrator, navigate to Arc Forge > Connections > Connectors, then click + Connect.



![](https://files.readme.io/29321427681023aeca66570a90fc28c092cd9b3a618a9477db7363f6b62c1ce9-image.png)

2. Select Hubspot.

3. In Typeface, connectors can be configured at the organization, team, or personal level. Select the desired connector level. Read more about connector-level access.

![](https://files.readme.io/0e6651f1dd13255eea374a99c76d3423d8cbd85aa34e851d9bc5b9ded1392b2d-image.png)

4. Enter the authentication settings using the access token copied in Step 1.

![](https://files.readme.io/3119471d1f5accda5810af9710e8507b6fe08b1da8d32ccf46ba7cbc49177e89-image.png)

5. Click Connect


# Importing Audience from Hubspot   [Skip link to Importing Audience from Hubspot](https://developers.typeface.ai/docs/integrations-hubspot-cdp\#importing-audience-from-hubspot)

From the main page, open the Audiences section.

![](https://files.readme.io/ea30f301a19b155a961f57a730c06ca949f9961ae1749c73fb0fca61d964158a-image.png)

To import audience, click on the import button and select Hubspot

![](https://files.readme.io/2b570342d472d179df2496ee8602c79986206224f4cbaf1ce0e448cd89a7c2ff-image.png)

Select the date from which you want to pull audiences, then click Import. The audiences will be imported shortly, and you’ll receive an email when the import is complete.

![](https://files.readme.io/44eeb9edb7cae8427b31fc9cf92507a6a4be98dc22ccd6e23b83c44d5ddf07da-image.png)
